exposure: body mass index (BMI) greater than or equal to 40
Postpartum antibiotic treatment (ertapenem vs. ampicillin, gentamicin and clindamycin vs. none)
cohort: 213 women with clinical chorioamnionitis who underwent cesarean delivery at a tertiary-care center between June 2010 and May 2013
finding: Elevated BMI, tobacco use, chronic hypertension, and leukocytosis at admission were associated with an increased risk of post-operative wound infection, while ertapenem appeared to reduce the risk.
mod_finding: The study examined risk factors for postoperative wound infection in women with chorioamnionitis who underwent cesarean delivery but did not specifically investigate the impact of mode of delivery itself.
